text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a global-scale modeling study focusing on the impact of future land-cover changes on atmospheric chemistry processes, specifically dry deposition velocities of ozone and nitric acid. The primary focus is on atmospheric chemistry and deposition modeling rather than on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. The land-cover changes used are derived from existing RCP scenarios and integrated assessment models, not predicted or simulated by the authors themselves. The study does not implement ≥2 future LULC prediction scenarios at a national scale with spatially explicit mapped outputs and quantitative accuracy metrics. It is a global-scale analysis without national-level disaggregation and does not meet core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction-focused research.)
